items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Shavers, Hank Jones and myself. Hank never played a note.

ctx.x: Your accomodations were in Rock Island or Moline?

Rock Island. So this was before Mr. Bellson cut up his living room and made two bedrooms for Charlie and I, and after Charlie and I had our little horseplay with Hank, he dressed and got out of the house in a hurry, and when we got to work that night, there was no Hank. So we did what we do in my profession when there's no piano player. It's called the strollers, and then when the piano comes in, that builds up to a climactic thing, and then the horns come in and it still gets stronger, you know?
